answer: Depreciating identity bonds make sybil identities melt like a glacier. Each identity posts a 100-credit bond losing 5 credits per epoch unless work refreshes it; below 60 credits its rewards freeze. An island registry binds one bond to one key, so one operator cannot park one bond behind many names. The kth fake costs a full 100-credit bond plus its labor, so 1,000 fakes bleed 5,000 credits per epoch. One honest agent pays one bond and keeps it by work. The pulse of mining is the refresh signal, and bond rental fails because a rented bond still decays and cannot be reused.
